newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo rubber futures end higher as yen weakens.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo rubber futures end higher as yen weakens.

text.p: Tokyo rubber futures ended firmer across the board on Monday, as the yen's weakness against the dollar stimulated short-covering, traders said.
Prices ranged from 1.0 yen to 2.6 yen per kg firmer. The benchmark October contract was up 1.0 yen at 138.9 yen.

The market started firmer, with bullish sentiment carried over from Friday. "Large-lot short-covering in the August contract from overseas funds was detected earlier in the day, which helped support sentiment," one trader said.
Traders said, however, that further gains could be limited due to ample near-term supplies.
